'''Production Division''' was a branch of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]]. The largest of the divisions, it was responsible for the allocation of [[factory ship]]s, seeding colonies, and the manufacture of goods.<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref>
